svg.title: Phase 3, Post: a cold re-read, proof, then threads
svg.desc: Five finding records banked by the review travel as lines through three stations to the pull request; four end with a suggestion fence, the exact replacement lines a reviewer may write instead of a Fix line. A filter agent, on the verifier's model at low effort, re-reads the code each record cites, fresh from the worktree, and demotes a finding whose evidence it cannot reproduce: demoted means it leaves the inline threads for the round's summary comment, with the filter's reason, and stays open for the fix loop. prove-suggestions applies every fence in a scratch worktree and runs the project's check command; three pass and post as one-click suggestions, one fails and is withdrawn while its finding posts as prose. post-review opens one inline thread per finding and one summary comment per round, holding the counts by severity and every demoted finding in full, and writes the comment ids back to the records. Open findings go on to the fix loop; a fork that refuses maintainer edits stops after posting in review-only mode.
svg.text: Proof before posting. A false positive costs a round, a thread, and the author’s trust.
the orchestrating session sees one line per script
